title: Capacity.
officialText:
A sewage pump or sewage ejector shall have the capacity and head for the application requirements. Pumps or
ejectors that receive the discharge of water closets shall be capable of handling spherical solids with a diameter of up to and
including 2 inches (51 mm). Other pumps or ejectors shall be capable of handling spherical solids with a diameter of up to and
including 1 inch (25.4 mm). The minimum capacity of a pump or ejector based on the diameter of the discharge pipe shall be in
accordance with Table 712.4.2.
Exceptions:
1. Grinder pumps or grinder ejectors that receive the discharge of water closets shall have a minimum discharge opening of
1¼ inches (32 mm).
2. Macerating toilet assemblies that serve single water closets shall have a minimum discharge opening of 3/ inch (19 mm).
